murray-bridge-1.name: Monarto Safari Park
murray-bridge-1.bio: Open-range safari park near Murray Bridge with lions, giraffes, rhinos and elephants, plus a bus loop through the grounds.

notes.cost: Adult $57 (child $32, concession $42), from park site; non-members must book a date-specific ticket. Open 9:30am-5pm daily.
notes.pin: Visitor centre/entrance off Murray Bridge Rd near Monarto South; draft point is a Wikipedia community point.

murray-bridge-2.name: Old Tailem Town
murray-bridge-2.bio: Pioneer village of more than 100 furnished period buildings near Tailem Bend, set out as a town from 1860 to 1960.

notes.cost: Adult $28 (pensioner/student $26, child 4-16 $11), from the village site; open 9am-4pm daily except Christmas Day.
notes.pin: Princes Highway, Tailem Bend (about 3 km south of the town); resolve from OSM tourism=attraction/museum or Wikipedia.

murray-bridge-3.name: Murray Bridge Regional Gallery
murray-bridge-3.bio: Public art gallery with three exhibition spaces behind the Murray Bridge town hall, showing South Australian artists.

notes.cost: Free entry per gallery programme page and SATC listing. Open Tue-Sat 10-4, Sun 11-4, closed Mon and public holidays.
notes.pin: 27 Sixth Street, behind the Town Hall (Murray Bridge town centre).

murray-bridge-4.name: Bertha the Bunyip
murray-bridge-4.bio: Animatronic bunyip at Sturt Reserve on the riverfront that rises from her cave and roars when you press the button.
murray-bridge-4.ticket_note: Council-run roadside attraction with no dedicated site; council pages are bot-blocked.

notes.cost: Free to view (coin-operated historically, now free per council news).
notes.status: Council reported a mechanical fault in 2023 with an augmented-reality version at her cave meanwhile; current working state unconfirmed.
notes.pin: At Sturt Reserve, Murray Bridge riverfront, at the bunyip's cave.

murray-bridge-5.name: Swanport Wetlands
murray-bridge-5.bio: Nineteen-hectare River Murray wetland with a boardwalk, bird hide and 1.2 km trail, reached via the Frank Jackman Lookout.
murray-bridge-5.ticket_note: Council reserve with no dedicated site; council page is bot-blocked.

notes.pin: Access from the Frank Jackman Memorial Lookout off the South Eastern Freeway east of Swanport Bridge; use the lookout car park / wetland trailhead.

murray-bridge-6.name: Rocky Gully Wetlands
murray-bridge-6.bio: Loop walk through wetlands off Mannum Road with more than 90 bird species, on the Lavender Federation Trail.
murray-bridge-6.ticket_note: Council reserve with no dedicated site.

notes.pin: Wetlands off Mannum Road; a circuit of about 1.8 km. Pin the loop midpoint, or the car park on Mannum Road.
notes.status: The Lavender Federation Trail site listed Rocky Gully closed due to flooding (undated); check before visiting.

murray-bridge-7.name: The Round House
murray-bridge-7.bio: Hexagonal 1876 house beside the Murray bridges, once a school and post office, with guided tours included in entry.

notes.cost: Adult $8, concession $5, child $3, family $15 (council page via search; history network listing agrees). Hours conflict between sources (weekends and holidays 11-3 vs Wed-Sun), so none written.
notes.pin: 146 Railway Terrace, Murray Bridge, beside the road and rail bridges.
notes.name: Renamed from 'The Round House (Murray Bridge)' (no qualifier).

murray-bridge-8.name: Captain's Cottage Museum
murray-bridge-8.bio: Local history museum in an 1890s cottage on Thomas Street, open weekends and public holidays.

notes.cost: Adult $5 per the council page and SATC listing; the draft's $1 is the child/older price. Child $3, family $10 per council. Closed on forecast 38C+ days.
notes.pin: 12 Thomas Street, Murray Bridge; Wikivoyage geotag for the listing gives about -35.1254, 139.265.

murray-bridge-9.name: Murray Bridge Discovery Trail
murray-bridge-9.bio: Signed 2.3 km town walk with an interpretive sign at each stop along the way.
murray-bridge-9.ticket_note: Council trail with no dedicated site; council page is bot-blocked.

notes.pin: Midpoint of the 2.3 km town circuit; start near the Sturt Reserve riverfront. Not the same route as the 10.3 km Water Discovery Trail (Avoca Dell to Swanport).

murray-bridge-10.name: Monarto Conservation Park
murray-bridge-10.bio: Semi-arid mallee park an hour from Adelaide, good for spotting southern scrub-robin, heathwren and malleefowl.

notes.cost: Free entry per NPWS SA page (title loaded: Monarto Conservation Park).
notes.pin: Use NPWS visitor access/car park, not the park centroid.

murray-bridge-11.name: Ferries-McDonald Conservation Park
murray-bridge-11.bio: Mallee park of 880 hectares with spring orchids, more than 80 bird species and the endangered malleefowl.

notes.cost: Free entry per NPWS SA page (title loaded).
notes.pin: Use an NPWS car park or track entry, not the centroid.

murray-bridge-12.name: Kinchina Conservation Park
murray-bridge-12.bio: Granite outcrops and spring orchids along the Lavender Federation Trail, with rare birds such as the diamond firetail.

notes.cost: Free entry per NPWS SA page (title loaded). Closed on Catastrophic fire danger days.
notes.pin: Parking bay off Maurice Road (draft note) near the Jailhouse Rocks loop of about 1.8 km.

destination.name: Murray Bridge
destination.tagline: Houseboats, river walks and an open-range safari an hour from Adelaide
destination.description: Murray Bridge is a city of about 17,500 on the River Murray, 76 km south-east of Adelaide, named for the road bridge opened here in 1879. The river brings houseboats, wakeboarding, fishing and walks along its banks and wetlands. Monarto Safari Park, on the plains west of town, keeps lions, giraffes, rhinos and elephants. Low rainfall and little light pollution on the outskirts also make it good for stargazing.
whyVisit: See lions and giraffes on safari

goodToKnow.title: Book Monarto ahead
goodToKnow.detail: Non-members need a date-specific ticket for Monarto Safari Park, so book before you drive out.

goodToKnow.title: Check flood closures
goodToKnow.detail: High river flows can close riverside trails and wetlands such as Rocky Gully. Check with the council before you walk.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Mild days in {months} suit river walks and the safari park, with spring wildflowers in the mallee.
